evidence.claim: Salicru deployed six of its modular SLC ADAPT2 online double-conversion UPS units equipped with lithium-ion batteries to provide power backup for the 4 MW Oxigen data centre facility in Sant Cugat del Vallès, Barcelona, according to a corporate announcement.

The company reports that its latest generation UPS models comply with the European Commission's energy efficiency Code of Conduct guidelines, delivering operational efficiencies ranging between 96% and 99% depending on the active configuration.

The company reports that its SLC ADAPT2 modular power protection systems support high-density configurations of up to 500 kW per cabinet, with the capability to scale vertically up to 12 modules per cabinet.

The company launched the SLC CUBE 4 R, an online double-conversion three-phase UPS system in a 19-inch rackmount format with power ratings ranging from 7.5 to 20 kVA, designed to require zero additional footprint within standard data center rack cabinet configurations.

Salicru offers the NIMBUS remote monitoring platform, consisting of embedded Linux network cards and the NIMBUS Cloud application, which utilizes MQTT protocols and InfluxDB to deliver real-time visibility, remote battery testing, and push notification alert logging for connected UPS hardware, as outlined on the Salicru NIMBUS Overview Page.

The company provides its proprietary UNMS II (UPS Network Management System) software tool, which serves as a centralized supervision and management layer capable of monitoring multiple UPS units across a local area network, as documented on the Salicru UNMS II Platform Page.

Salicru deployed its SLC ADAPT2 modular UPS systems to protect the IT infrastructure and auxiliary services at the Oxigen data centre in Sant Cugat del Vallès, Spain, incorporating high-efficiency systems and lithium-ion batteries that provide real-time status monitoring for responsive incident management.
